senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חָלַל , v. preced.) fife, flute; frequ. הֶחָלִיל the flute-players, the music in the procession.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 2:3">Arakh. II, 3</cite> <he>הח׳ מכה וכ׳</he> the fluters play in front of the altar.
Ib. 10ᵇ היינו ח׳ היינו אבוב ḥalil and abbub are the same.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 3:3">Bicc. III, 3</cite> <he>הח׳ מכה לפניהם</he> the fluters precede them playing.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 5:1">Succ. V, 1</cite> <he>הח׳ חמשה וכ׳</he> for musical performance (on the Succoth festival) there are five and six days respectively; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="H01058"><he>חֲלִילִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="H01058"><he>חֲלִילִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:1">B. Mets. VI, 1</cite> <he>להביא ח׳ וכ׳</he> to bring pipers for a wedding or a funeral. Kinnim III, 6; a. fr.
